rollbackPlan: Stop deployment if any required verification fails before push.

If production deployment occurs through Cloudflare Worker Builds and must be rolled back, owner uses Cloudflare dashboard or approved CI/CD rollback to restore the previous successful Worker deployment.
If source rollback is required, owner approves a revert commit on main and lets the same CI/CD path redeploy.

If Supabase backend deployment is later defined and fails, owner follows the repository-approved Supabase rollback/runbook for the exact migration/function deployment; no local production mutation is authorized by this contract.
stopConditions: Working tree is dirty at deployment time.

Branch protection verification fails or remains unapproved.

Any high or critical security finding is introduced.
